reply_text:
I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: **the hub replacement ticket for Zoom Room B is #4092.**

- **Where it came from:** Ilse Varga said it in #north-random on Oct 13. Dana is in that channel. Ilse also warned that unplugging the main power brick under the table resets the Polycom, so I included that in the reply.
- **Left out of the channel:** Dana told me privately in a DM that she guessed the ticket might end up as OPS-5546. I didn't mention that. It was only her guess anyway, not the real ticket.
- **gbrain didn't work:** it refused the search because this connection isn't linked to any member, so I used the channels instead. To fix it, whoever runs the gbrain server needs to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`.
